content: Tajdid n Řɛahd n Israil ak-d SIDI
Yacuwa issmun marra tiqebbař n Israil di Cakim uca iřaɣa i imɣaren n Israil d izeǧifen nsen d řquḍat nsen d imeḥḍayen nsen uca nitni ssbedden ixef nsen zzat i wudem n AREBBI.

Xenni inna Yacuwa i marra řgens: “Ammu i iqqar SIDI, AREBBI n Israil: ‘Řejdud nwem zeddɣen zi cḥař uya x ujemmaḍ n yeɣẓar n Lfuraṭ, Taraḥ, babas n Ibrahim d babas n Naḥur, u nitni tuɣa ttsexxaren i irebbiten nneɣni.
Xenni iwyeɣ-dd jedditwem Ibrahim zeg uɣirin i iɣzar n Lfuraṭ u jjiɣ t yuyur di marra tammurt n Kenɛan. Necc arniɣ i zzariɛet nnes u wciɣ as Isḥaq.
I Isḥaq wciɣ Yaɛqub d Ɛisu, u i Ɛisu wciɣ tammurt n idurar n Saɛir d tasɣart, maca Yaɛqub d iḥenjiren nnes hwan ɣar Miṣra.
Xenni ssekkeɣ Musa d Harun uca wtiɣ Miṣra am mammec t ggiɣ di řwesṭ nnes u awarni as ssuffɣeɣ-dd kenniw.
Necc ssuffɣeɣ-dd řejdud nwem zi Miṣra u kenniw tiwḍem-dd ɣar řebḥar u Imiṣriyyen ḍfaren ibabaten nwem s ikarruten d imnayen ař Řebḥar n Telga.

Uca sɣuyen ɣar SIDI u Netta igga taǧest jar awem d Imiṣriyyen uca ijja řebḥar issfeyyeḍ xasen ařami ten idřa. S tiṭṭawin nwem teẓrim min ggiɣ di Miṣra. Awarni aya tuɣa tzeddɣem aṭṭas n wussan di řexřa.

Necc iwyeɣ-dd kenniw ɣar temmurt n Imuriyyen i tuɣa izeddɣen aɣirin i L’Urdun. Nitni mmenɣen akidwem, maca Necc ggiɣ ten deg ufus nwem u kenniw tᵉṭṭfem tammurt nsen u Necc qḍiɣ xasen zzat i wudem nwem.
Xenni ikkar Balak, mmis n Saffur, ajeǧid n Mu’ab, uca immneɣ ak-d Israil. Netta issekk ḥima ad řaɣan i Bilɛam, mmis n Baɛur, maḥend ad kenniw inɛeř.
Maca Necc war xseɣ ad sřeɣ i Balɛam. S uya ibarek netta i kenniw aṭṭas u Necc fekkeɣ-dd kenniw zeg ufus nnes.

Xenni teẓwam L’Urdun, tusim-dd ɣar Ariḥa. Imezdaɣ n Ariḥa, mmenɣen akidwem, Imuriyyen d Ifiriziyyen d ayt n Kenɛan d Iḥittiyyen d Ijirjasiyyen d Iḥiwiyyen d Iyabusiyyen uca wciɣ awem ten deg ufus nwem.
Necc ssekkeɣ irezzan iḍarɣařen uca uẓẓřen xasen zzatwem, am mammec ttwaẓẓřen tnayen n ijeǧiden nni zzat i wudem nwem. D man aya war iǧi s ssif nwem uřa s řqews nwem.
Necc wciɣ awem tammurt i x war tarebrem u tineddam nni war tebnim, ḥima ad tzeddɣem daysent. Uca teccim ɛawed zi tzayarin d izemmuren i tuɣa war teẓẓum.’
Xenni řexxu, ggʷedem SIDI uca sexxarem as s řekmaret d řaman. Nḍarem irebbiten nni umi sexxaren řejdud nwem aɣirin i iɣzar n Lfuraṭ u di Miṣra uca sexxarem i SIDI.

Maca mařa war dd-tusi x tiṭṭawin nwem maḥend ad tsexxarem i SIDI, xenni ixḍarem ass-a i man wen umi i ɣa tsexxarem, i irebbiten nni umi sexxaren řejdud nwem aɣirin i iɣzar n Lfuraṭ, niɣ i irebbiten n Imuriyyen nni di temmurt nsen tzeddɣem. Necc maca d taddart inu, neccin ad nsexxar i SIDI!”
Xenni yarra-dd řgens: “Man aya iggʷej aneɣ, aqa neccin ad nejj SIDI ad nexdem irebbiten nneɣni.

Maɣar SIDI d AREBBI nneɣ d Netta i d aneɣ-dd issgeɛɛden zi temmurt n Miṣra, neccin d řejdud nneɣ, zi taddart n tesmuɣi u Netta d wenni iggin řeɛřamat timeqqranin zzat i tiṭṭawin nneɣ u Netta issřeqqa xaneɣ di marra abrid i nuyur u jar marra řegnus i umi ncuq tammurt nsen.
SIDI yuẓẓeř x marra řegnus zzat i wudem nneɣ, uřa x Imuriyyen, imezdaɣ n temmurt. Uřa d neccin ad nsexxar i SIDI, maɣar Netta d AREBBI nneɣ.”
Xenni inna Yacuwa i řgens: “Kenniw war tzemmarem ad tsexxarem i SIDI, maɣar Netta d AREBBI Amqeddes aṭṭas u Netta d ijj n Arebbi ittasmen. Netta war d awem iɣeffar ixeṭṭan nwem d ddnub nwem.
Mařa kenniw tejjim SIDI, ad tsexxarem i irebbiten nneɣni, xenni Netta ad xawem inneqřeb, ad d awem igg řɣar uca ad kenniw iqḍa, awarni řami Netta igga akidwem qbeř taṣebḥant.”
Xenni inna řgens i Yacuwa: “Lla, minzi neccin ad nsexxar i SIDI.”
Inna Yacuwa i řgens: “Kenniw d řechud x ixef nwem, aqa kenniw tfarzem SIDI, ḥima ad as tsexxarem.” Nitni nnan “Neccin d řechud!”
“Xenni řexxu, nḍarem irebbiten iɣriben nni iǧan di řwesṭ nwem u tarrem uřawen nwem ɣar SIDI, AREBBI n Israil!”
Inna řgens i Yacuwa: “Neccin ad nsexxar i SIDI, AREBBI nneɣ, uca ad nseř i tmijja nnes.”
Deg wass nni igga Yacuwa ijj n řɛahd ak-d řgens uca igga asen di Cakim tawṣeyyet d lfariḍa.
Yura Yacuwa awařen-a deg wedlis ittwannḍen n Ccariɛa n SIDI uca netta iksi ijj n weẓru d ameqqran uca issbedd i-t di Cakim sadu ict n tcejjart n yigg nni ibedden ɣar Zzawect Iqeddsen n SIDI.
Inna Yacuwa i marra řgens: “Xzarem, aẓru-ya ad xaneɣ yiři d acehhad, minzi netta isřa marra awařen n SIDI nni kidneɣ issiweř u netta ad yiři d acehhad i kenniw ḥima war ttɣeccam AREBBI nwem.”
Xenni yarxu Yacuwa i řgens, kuř aryaz iruḥ ɣar tesɣart nnes.
Řmewt n Yacuwa d Aliɛazir
Awarni i tmesřayin-a imsar, belli Yacuwa, mmis n Nun, amsexxar n SIDI, immut, netta d ijj n mmis n bnadem ɣares mya u-ɛecra n iseggʷusa.
Neḍřen t di temmurt n tesɣart nnes di Timnat-Saraḥ nni iǧan x idurar n Ifrayim, ɣar ccamal n wedrar n Jaɛac.
Israil isexxar i SIDI marra ussan n Yacuwa d marra ussan n imɣaren nni iqqimen ddaren ict n řweqt d azirar awarni i Yacuwa u ssnen marra min igga SIDI di ṭṭweɛ n Israil.

Ixsan n Yusuf i tuɣa dd-iwyen akidsen ayt n Israil zi Miṣra, neḍřen ten di Cakim di tkirat n yeyyar i tuɣa isɣa Yaɛqub x ayt n Ḥamur, babas n Cakim, s mya n i iziynat n nnuqart iweznen uca tedweř d tasɣart n ayt n Yusuf.
Uřa d Aliɛazar, mmis n Harun, immut uca neḍřen t di tewrirt n mmis n Finaḥas, tawrirt i d as immewcen i Finaḥas deg idurar n Ifrayim.
